newsitem.title: UK: General Accident up as broker rates "buy".
newsitem.headline: General Accident up as broker rates "buy".

text.p: Shares in General Accident Plc rose sharply for a second day on Wednesday after upbeat comment on the potential benefits of mergers in the sector and as Cazenove issued a "buy" rating on the stock, traders said. The stock was up 11-1/2p at 728 by 0946 GMT in modest volume of 202,357 shares, after yesterday jumping 21p amid market talk of a merger with Commercial Union Plc, down 5p at 688.
Commenting on the latest outbreak of speculation in the sector, the Financial Times' influential Lex column said a merger could make "powerful sense" for Commercial Union.
"Not only would there be benefits from cost-cutting but CU's rivals could also do with a dose of its level-headed management," Lex said.
However it added that CU was vulnerable to disappointment if no deal emerges since it was trading at a 15 percent premium to net asset value.
Cazenove maintains a policy of not commenting on its stock recommendations.
